title: Proxy: the home server rejected the user
plain_english: The request was forwarded to a home server for this realm, and that server answered Access-Reject. This server only relayed the answer, so its own log cannot tell you why. The reason is in the home server's log at the same timestamp.

causes.cause: The home server has its own reason: wrong password, unknown user, policy. It is logged there, not here.
causes.next_check: Find the same request on the home server (radiusd -X output, or NPS event 6273 with the same account and time) and paste that here.

causes.cause: Realm stripping changed the identity: the home server received a user name it does not recognize (with or without the @realm part).
causes.next_check: Check 'strip' on the realm in proxy.conf and compare the User-Name in the proxied Access-Request with what the home server expects.
